skills.name: Tribute
lines: Magic attack on a single enemy (S) (guaranteed critical)
* When not in Another Force, if another party member has used a magic attack this turn, change current Tribute:
** Apply Element of that magic attack
** Apply and Double skill multiplier of last hit from that magic attack
*** strength conditionals are taken into reference
*** increase damage conditionals are ignored

*** NOTICE: Global version does not yet have differentiation of these 2 types in in-game descriptions. Japanese version started to fix descriptions to differentiate them. Descriptions in wiki may not be correct the same.
**** Example: 2 types of when HP is less: Esh Heres (increase damage) vs Cherev Messiah (increase skill)
* Replaces the basic attack when not in Another Force.

lines: Intelligence and Spirit of user +250 and [skill multipliers] increase by 50% (Multiplier x1.5)

** Any skill uses including basic attack, 0 mp skills, non attacking skills.
** Miracle form consumption calculated from current mp value after skill consumption
* in End of Turn, when user has <50% MP left: Miracle form ends

skills.name: Stream Glare
lines: Water type magic attack on all enemies (XL)
* [consume MP] 10% of current MP (Max: 100 MP) (Unaffected by MP cost change effects; consumes MP even in Another Force)
* [skill multiplier] is based on MP consumed by consumption effect:
** Formula: 30% x [consumed MP] (Max: [3000% x MOD])
* When in Miracle Form: Guaranteed critical, ignores target's defense (MDef=0 in Damage Formula)
** [consumed MP] is taken from current MP after Miracle Form -10% effect happens.
*** Order of calculation from max 656 MP
**** 656 - 0 MP (Skill MP Cost) = 656 MP
**** 656 - 65 (-10% Miracle Form, rounds down) = 591 MP
**** 591 - [59] (-10% Skill effect, rounds down) = 532 MP left
